caption:
GTA 6 cheat codes that actually work 🎮 Save this so you have them when you finish the story 📌

How: finish the main story, open the phone (D-pad up), hold L1 + R1 (LB + RB on Xbox) and press the arrows. Each cheat also has its own unlock (it's on every card). Cheats turn off saving and trophies for that session, so save first.

Codes as listed by GameSpot, PC Gamer, GamesRadar, Screen Rant and Vice. Full list: vicereplay.com (link in bio)
